# LazyTopper

> LazyTopper is a CBSE Class 10 board-exam preparation web app for Maths and Science, for students in India. Students check their written answers step by step, the way a CBSE examiner marks them, and practise with chapter notes, competency-based questions and chapter-wise exam trends drawn from ten years of CBSE board papers.

Key facts:
- Audience: students preparing for the CBSE Class 10 board exam (2026-27 session, boards in 2027), and their parents.
- Subjects: Class 10 Maths and Science only, on the current CBSE syllabus.
- Check & Improve: a student photographs or uploads a written answer and sees the marks for every step and where marks were lost. The first check is free without an account.
- Free without an account: chapter notes, chapter pages, Exam Trends, the CBSE Class 10 papers page and the practice hub.
- Signing up starts a 7-day Premium trial with no card needed; after it the student keeps the free Basic plan or upgrades to Premium.
- Important Questions: chapter-wise important questions drawn from ten years of CBSE board papers. LazyTopper does not claim to know the questions of any upcoming exam.
- LazyTopper is an independent platform and is not affiliated with CBSE.

## Start here

- [Exam Trends](https://www.lazytopper.com/exam-trends): every Class 10 chapter ranked by exam weightage, from ten years of CBSE board papers
- [CBSE Class 10 Boards 2027](https://www.lazytopper.com/cbse/class-10): official CBSE papers for Class 10 Maths and Science, the official 2026-27 sample papers and marking schemes, unit-wise marks, dates and exam rules
- [How CBSE examiners mark answers](https://www.lazytopper.com/check-your-answer): step marking, where marks are lost, and worked examples from past Class 10 board papers
- [For parents](https://www.lazytopper.com/for-parents): how LazyTopper helps a Class 10 student, and how to send it to your child
- [NCERT Class 10 books](https://www.lazytopper.com/ncert-class-10): all 27 chapters of the 2026-27 NCERT Class 10 Mathematics and Science textbooks, each with its notes and practice
